regenerate: the prover is deterministic; recert_campaign.py --families 3c 3c_t2 morph144 regenerates those proofs, whose sha256 is listed per cell, bit for bit

aborted_attempts.rule: a run whose prover wrote no proof and printed nothing was stopped, not refuted; it decides nothing, and its cell was completed by another run
